title: ARB RED Witness Receipt
description: Evidence that a BEHAVIOR-REQ test was observed failing against the base tree, with the production hunks withheld (GHI #642).

req_id.description: The BEHAVIOR REQ whose falsifiability this receipt witnesses.

test_names.description: unittest-addressable names executed against the base tree.

obpi_id.description: Owning OBPI, when the witness ran inside a pipeline.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the base-tree run.

git.description: Git context of the working tree that produced the test hunks.

base_commit.description: The commit the test ran against, with production hunks withheld.

exit_status.description: Exit code of the base-tree test run. Zero means NO RED.

failure_class.description: assertion = strong RED; error = weak RED (failed for the wrong reason, e.g. ImportError on a not-yet-existing symbol); none = the test passed without its implementation and therefore cannot fail.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the base-tree run.

output_tail.description: Tail of the base-tree run's combined output.
